They surface legacy Hartree, multishell, finite-grid, and comparison records, all carrying the legacy discovery warning; none supplies the current A1 three-component production generator together with mobility, heat_root_incidence, root-labelled filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner, and a once-owned nonnegative q-ledger. decision_reason: A semantically similar phrase or a revalidated legacy calculation is not a production owner. Promoting any returned source would import its kinetic law, field space, regulator, normalization, and reference state without satisfying the R-192 first-failure contract. The correct disposition is to keep the QFT candidates quarantined and require a hash-pinned owner crosswalk.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing bounded discovery evidence only. It does not prove global source absence, refute a future QFT construction, close R-192/R-193, establish an interacting measure, OS/KMS or real-time dynamics, select a physical vacuum, or close A13, T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, thermodynamic, continuum, or physical-empty routes.

Advance only when a stable authority hash-pins the A1 production generator and mobility together with heat_root_incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial identity, and the one-use nonnegative q-ledger; then rerun the unchanged R-192 owner order.
